intro:
Hi! I’m Home Dream, Triple Z Build’s automated project assistant. We help with custom homes, additions and major remodels around Seattle. See our work: https://triplezbuild.com/
Are you planning a project or just exploring?
handoff: I’ll ask the team to confirm this detail, and I can keep helping here. Would you like a free initial consultation with a member of our team?
optout: Understood — we won’t send further outreach. Thank you for letting us know.
quoteDisabled: The team will review the scope before providing a price. I can help arrange a free initial consultation with a team member.
followup: Happy to continue with your project details whenever you’re ready.
